maria (marketing): Quick final sync for the 6.2 announce. Need green on these before we send embargoed email Tue 10:30am PT:
- final changelog URL
- docs + migration snippet link
- canary/rollout timing for hosted API
- perf artifacts for blog and webinar slides
- inbound lead webhook test endpoint + sample payload
Who can confirm each item?

ryan (eng): Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/528 will be merged when the canary starts.
Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1123 staging-ready.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: ID 6792 started by ryan at 2026-03-24T09:40:00-07:00. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/6792

jay (docs): Docs are on staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v6-2
I'll add a short "Upgrade notes" snippet showing the migration diff + a sample curl for the webhook. Will promote to prod after canary passes.

olivia (sales): For lead routing, sales needs webhook fields mapped to SF fields: email, company, title, demo_optin(true/false), company_size, region, utm_campaign. HMAC auth required.
Can we get a staging endpoint to validate mapping?

ryan (eng): Staging hook: https://hooks.staging.redwood.ai/mktg/leads
Auth header: x-rw-hmac: sha256=<signature>. We'll store test secret in Secrets Manager and share.
Sample payload for docs (one-line):
```
{"email":"tester@acme.com","company":"Acme Inc","title":"CTO","demo_optin":true,"company_size":"51-200","region":"NA","utm_campaign":"launch-6-2"}
```
I'll add the curl example to the docs PR.

matt (pm): Webinar rehearsal Wed 11am PT. For slides we want a conservative benchmark headline. Proposal from eng: "Up to 2x throughput; typical 20-35% cost savings depending on workload." Maria ok with that wording?

maria (marketing): That wording works. We'll bury exact test params in appendix and link the perf CSV. Need a PNG of the perf table for the blog hero.

ryan (eng): Perf artifacts uploaded: s3://perf-release-6-2/reports.zip
Per-route CSV: s3://perf-release-6-2/per_route.csv
We'll include test harness link in docs so folks can reproduce. Note: numbers are medians and P95s.

jay (docs): I'll export the P50/P95 table to PNG for marketing and add the harness link + reproduction steps to the appendix. Also will include the webhook mapping and curl.

olivia (sales): Once staging webhook is live, we'll run an end-to-end test with SF mapping and confirm the demo queue. Please add a short mapping table in docs showing SF field names.

rayan (eng): (typo) meant ryan: will add SF field mapping example.

maria (marketing): Perfect. Marketing will schedule the embargoed send and post the blog right after full rollout. Ping this thread when canary finishes and when docs are promoted to prod. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
